_readme: S739 wave B, the gap census's Next wave (census of 2026-11-26 06:54Z, run 45771011713; levers reader_page_assignment and paid_read): 1 general-education pattern certificate of Santa Rosa Junior College whose state listing is the pattern's course list. The college's other program on the lever, Cal-GETC GE Pattern 37014, is already held for a person (kb/program_requirements_college/santa_rosa_junior/held_for_person/37014.json, S689) and is not filed again here. Filed as named gaps and never sent to a paid read. Each filed record stays as filed (the load skips a record that places none of its listed courses). No model call, no Supabase write. Each is the college's to settle in COCI or its catalog.
